```{r}
library(dplyr)

```

```{r}

muni <- read.csv("../interim/IBGE_population-projections/IBGE_births-deaths_mun-estimated.csv")
muni 

```


```{r}
# regress directly on pop counts

muni.ids <- unique(muni$CD_MUN)

predicted.pops <- data.frame()

for (muni.id in muni.ids) {
  
  muni.data <- muni %>%
    filter(CD_MUN == muni.id,
           year >= 2001,
           year <= 2006)
  
  pop.model <- lm(population ~ year, data = muni.data)
  birth.model <- lm(estimated_births ~ year, data = muni.data)
  death.model <- lm(estimated_deaths ~ year, data = muni.data)
  
  years <- data.frame(year = 1996:2000)
  
  pop.preds <- predict(pop.model, years)
  birth.preds <- predict(birth.model, years)
  death.preds <- predict(death.model, years)
  
  temp.df <- data.frame(
    CD_MUN = muni.id,
    year = 1996:2000,
    population = pop.preds,
    estimated_births = birth.preds,
    estimated_deaths = death.preds
  )
  
  predicted.pops <- rbind(predicted.pops, temp.df)
}

muni.new <- bind_rows(
  muni,
  predicted.pops
) %>%
  arrange(CD_MUN, year)

muni.new <- muni.new %>%
  mutate(
    population = round(population),
    estimated_births = round(estimated_births),
    estimated_deaths = round(estimated_deaths))

```

```{r}

sample.plot <- muni.new %>% filter(CD_MUN == 3524402)
plot(sample.plot$year, sample.plot$population)

plot(sample.plot$year, sample.plot$estimated_births)
plot(sample.plot$year, sample.plot$estimated_deaths)


```

```{r}
write.csv(muni.new,
          "../interim/IBGE_population-projections/municipality_population_1996-2024_estimated.csv",
          row.names = FALSE)

```
